Then of course there is donating. One-time donations are great, and are most common during times like these when Voat has a stated need for funding. We are now covering 1/5 of the current operating costs, and given time and a team of volunteers these should be lowered drastically before much longer. I am also convinced that not all those who are donating to Voat monthly are on this list. Thus if everyone who makes these pledges sticks to them, coupled with a drop in operating costs I know we goats can keep Voat alive. So if you can afford it and if you are willing, make a pledge and we'll keep this Voat boat floating.

Finally there is the consideration of volunteering. Putt's Voat inbox is overflowing so trying to reach him through PM will likely be unsuccessful. He suggests emailing him at hello@voat.co for serious proposals to volunteer for Voat in some way. There are a lot of goats out there with a lot of different and valuable skills so we should have no issue filling the slots that need filling.
